NOTE: verse_ids anu-p01.. collide corpus-wide with anubhavanivedana’s — files work-scoped (no overwrite), owner eyes needed on corpus id-uniqueness.

lines: Things do not arise; by nature they shine through your beholding — even the untrue partakes of truth for a moment, through experience’s delusion.
This glory of worlds is will-born of You, with birth from nowhere else — so in splendor You shine through the worlds, one and yet many-selfed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhāvānāṃ na samudbhavo 'sti sahajas tvadbhāvitā bhānty amī niḥsatyā api satyatām anubhavabhrāntyā bhajanti kṣaṇam | tvatsaṅkalpaja eṣa viśvamahimā nāsty asya janmānyataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vibhavena bhāsi bhuvaneṣv ekopy anekātmakaḥ

verses.craft: No-arising + momentary-truth + will-born + one-yet-many-selfed (non-cancelling kept); sahaja/bhrānti/ekopy opens kept; You-capital kept. UPSTREAM NOTE: C1 essence len 1 vs L3 maps [0..2]; L4 mirrors L3.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving one-yet-many → killed: non-cancelling is the verse. (b) lowercasing You → killed: address is the Lord.
